correctness.rationale: Five-column equivalence holds for every prism order at least seven; all other vertex pairs have disjoint closed neighborhoods and are separated by total domination. Exactly 661 transitions and one 147-state cyclic component with 489 arcs are reconstructed. The 147x147 integer min-plus powers satisfy D16=D9+6 entrywise (21,609 equalities), yielding recurrence at every n>=9 by matrix associativity. Base traces n7..13 and direct enumeration n3..6 establish the entire piecewise formula. Independent subset enumeration n3..8, full local/global equivalence n7,8, and reconstructed witnesses corroborate the critical construction. The full verifier has been replayed from its package path.

value.rationale: Natural infinite cubic vertex-transitive prism family studied by earlier sensor-location literature, with new exact sharp periodic correction across all orders rather than a small table. A published weaker locating-total construction yields a gap at least 2n/35 on n divisible by 35, so the stronger identification requirement has an unbounded linear cost. A finite min-plus recurrence gives an independently reproducible structural method. No broader graph-family or all-optima census is asserted.
